name: sysmlv2
description: SysML v2 and KerML language support via the sysmlv2 language server: exact dialect-aware highlighting, live diagnostics, outline, formatting.

sysmlv2.serverPath.description: Path to the sysmlv2 binary (the server runs as `sysmlv2 lsp`).

sysmlv2.numberFormat.markdownDescription: How value hints, hover values and range hints write a rational without a terminating decimal expansion: `exact` (`1/15`), `approx` (`≈0.06666666666666667`), `overline` (`0.06̅`), `parens` (`0.0(6)`) or `unicode` (`¹/₁₅`), then optional settings after commas, e.g. `overline,period=3` or `unicode,mixed=false` (see `sysmlv2 lsp --help`). Applies when the server starts; a spec the server cannot read shows a warning and keeps `exact`.

enumDescriptions: The evaluator's units: a bracket's unit, kept through sums and scaling, and SI units for products, quotients and powers (`10 ['in'] / (2 [s])` shows `0.127 [m/s]`).
The units each value was written in, where they cover its dimensions (`10 ['in'] / (2 [s])` shows `5 [in/s]`).
sysmlv2.valueHintUnits.markdownDescription: Which units value hints, range hints, violated-verdict code lenses and hover values show quantities in. Hover shows the other reading too when it differs. Applies when the server starts.
